title: A characterization of Banach spaces with numerical index one
summary: We investigate the extremal properties of the unit ball of $L(X)_w^*$, the dual space of bounded linear operators defined on a Banach space $X$ equipped with the numerical radius norm. As an application of the present study, we obtain a geometric characterization of Banach spaces with numerical index one, which extends the well-known McGregor's characterization of finite-dimensional Banach spaces with numerical index one.
